request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE NEW Execution Workshop building for the same original strategy-game civilization as the reference Memory Archive. Use the reference as a strict architectural art-direction guide, NOT as the building to reproduce. Retain its broad stepped terraces, generous dark slate ceramic eaves, warm pale limestone, aged copper structural accents, compact polygonal base and hand-crafted stylized finish. Change the massing clearly: a LOW HORIZONTAL artisan/compute workshop, two broad staggered work-hall wings around a deep open loading arch, a short sturdy rear exhaust or ventilation stack. Width dominates height. Substantial beams and restrained copper braces, a small amber interior accent. No library tower or lantern crown, no modern industrial factory, no religious temple. Readable at elevated isometric map scale. Show one complete standalone building in a clean three-quarter elevated view on a plain neutral background. Keep all sides inside frame. No scenery, ground tile, characters, text, logos, gears used as signs, floating parts, thin railings, excessive weathering or dramatic baked shadows. Distinct workshop silhouette but unmistakably from the reference building's family.

request.text_style_prompt: Original knowledge-city execution workshop, a low twin-wing artisan and compute hall around a central loading arch with a short rear stack. Warm pale limestone walls and stepped plinth. Dark slate ceramic gabled roofs and central roof. Aged copper-bronze structural beams, posts, eave brackets, window frames, open double doors and rear stack cap with restrained verdigris. Recessed window panels in dark copper-bronze and warm amber interior glow inside the central arch. Broad calm hand-crafted stylized material regions readable from an elevated strategy-game camera, subtle stone variation, restrained weathering. Preserve the geometry. No text, logos, grime, baked lighting or baked shadows. Limestone matte, slate moderately rough, copper metallic.
